summary: Round 1 on PR #1079 at head 888e3e65952ae9ece2af90fa1a617623e63d9b8a: REQUEST_CHANGES. One correctness finding against the LEGION-101 contract: RequestCoreTo's Conn.Flush() (FlushTimeout(10s) in nats.go v1.50.0) returns the same nats.ErrTimeout sentinel as the receipt wait, so a forward still sitting in the client's buffer during a NATS reconnect or a stalled connection is reported as receipt_timeout, which the daemon treats as delivered and the message is lost; it was delivery_failed and recovered before this change. One gate item: the PR body has no E2E (tester) line. One small hardening: an explicit dedupe_key beginning envoy.role.forward. on a role topic gets a 200 and is silently dropped by roleTopicDelivery's first guard. Every other contract clause is met; CI green at the head; MERGEABLE; no .omp/config.yml on the branch.
